description: Très Haut Débit : Calendrier de déploiement des prises par commune en is a series of datasets listed in data.corsica open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Collectivité de Corse. La convention de délégation de service public relative à la conception, construction, exploitation du réseau de communications électroniques très haut débit (FTTH) a été signée avec la société SFR Collectivités (puis SFR FTTH, nommée aujourd’hui XpFibre) le 16 octobre 2018, pour une durée de 30 ans. Coverage: Corsica. The portal lists 51 near-identical datasets in this series (one per month, area, counter or year), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under Digital and Telecommunications. Its keywords are Tres haut debit, FTTH, fibre-optique, numerique, DTAN, ambizione digitale. The portal shows 344 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-05-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-data-corsica-portal.
